children: Australian shares were set to open up slightly on Tuesday as higher copper prices lifted miners, with weaker gold stocks likely limiting gains while investors braced for the minutes of the Reserve Bank of Australia's September meeting.
The local share price index futures (YAPcm1) rose 0.1%, a 28.8-point premium to the underlying S&P/ASX 200 index
close. The benchmark rose 0.8% on Monday.
